FPT Software · Water networks

AQUADVANCED

Modernizing the frontend of real-time water network software.

Role
Principal Software Engineer
Organization
FPT Software · SUEZ
Period
Jun 2024 – Feb 2026

Overview

AQUADVANCED is SUEZ’s suite of real-time software for drinking water networks, wastewater treatment, and urban drainage. The application uses OpenLayers to support work with geographical network data.

My contributions

  • Refine requirements with customers and developers in France and Singapore, contributing estimates and identifying implementation difficulties.
  • Implement frontend features with Angular, RxJS, Material UI, TypeScript, SCSS, and OpenLayers.
  • Contribute to UI and UX decisions and review code with developers across the international team.
  • Write frontend unit and integration tests.
  • Migrate legacy AngularJS and Angular 6 applications toward Angular 20 within a micro-frontend architecture using Module Federation.

International delivery

I was the sole Vietnamese member and FPT representative on a team of 20+ people across France, Singapore, and Vietnam.

The role combined hands-on frontend delivery with responsibility for the project outcome and direct collaboration with customers.

Technologies

  • Angular
  • TypeScript
  • RxJS
  • Material UI
  • SCSS
  • OpenLayers
  • Module Federation
